page.overview:
Who is Ben Doordan?

Ben Doordan is a minor character in Cars. He is a small pick-up truck and Ponchy Wipeout's crew chief.

In Cars, Ben can be seen at the Motor Speedway of the South, coaching Ponchy Wipeout and his team to win the Dinoco 400.
